nodes.label: Dashboard getting-started onboarding checklist
Per-tenant collapse / dismiss / completed-at localStorage keys
Rationale: checklist self-hides seven days after all steps complete
Collapsed header surfaces the next incomplete step by priority
'You're Live' celebration banner after setup completes
Rationale: dismissed defaults to true so the banner never flashes before the localStorage read
Convention: dashboard banners persist dismissal under a tenant-id-suffixed storage key
Integration status and test/live mode surface
Integration catalog: Stripe, Bonzah, BoldSign, credits, Veriff, notifications, Tesla Fleet
Integration status vocabulary: live / test / configured / not_configured / coming_soon
Low credit-wallet balance warning with top-up call to action
Rationale: credits fund e-sign, SMS and licence checks, so an empty wallet halts them
Global plus per-tenant maintenance / status notice strip
Tenant-scoped banners always render as 'warning'; only global banners carry a severity
Platform subscription mode banner (trial / live / expired)
Rationale: hide the 'You're Live' state seven days after wentLiveAt
Trial copy promises everything runs in test mode for the duration of the trial
Tenant recent-activity feed (payments, rentals, vehicles, system)
allowedTypes prop lets the dashboard filter activity rows by the viewer's permissions
30-day revenue and rental-volume overview
Week-over-week revenue trend (last 7 days vs previous 7)
Convention: React Query keys are ['<name>', tenant?.id] and gated on enabled: !!tenant
Day buckets are pre-seeded for the full interval so gaps render as zero instead of vanishing
Trial-window Setup Hub with live countdown and integration checklist
Rationale: Stripe Connect and Bonzah run in test mode during setup and auto-switch to live when the window ends
Recurring setup-reminder nudge for subscribed tenants with outstanding tasks
Paywall interlock: the nudge never renders alongside SubscriptionGateDialog
Stripe UK-to-UAE migration interlock suppresses the nudge and drops the Stripe row
Session snooze (sessionStorage) vs permanent dismissal (localStorage)
Rationale: a 24h timestamp let a tenant hide the nudge for the whole day across fresh logins
Flags carry the tenant id they were read for, guarding against a stale render after a tenant switch
In-dialog tenant logo upload that completes without navigating away
Rationale: the company-logos bucket has no server-side MIME or size limit, so the client checks are the only gate
Logo write fan-out: dark_logo_url cleared, auth_logo_url copied, only when still tracking logo_url
Rationale: .select() is load-bearing because PostgREST answers 204 for an RLS-filtered zero-row UPDATE
Rationale: refetchTenant() never carries logo_url, so the tenant-branding invalidation is what repaints the sidebar
Rationale: max-h plus overflow-y keeps the close and 'Don't show me again' controls reachable on a landscape phone
company-logos storage bucket with tenant-namespaced object paths
Enquiry triage drawer: mark read, change status, contact, delete
Contact-via-Messages handoff resolves the enquiry to a customer, flips status to contacted, deep-links to /messages
Rationale: cache the pending delete and stagger the sheet close so the confirm dialog is not stacked behind it
Manager per-tab 'enquiries' edit gating disables status, delete and contact
An enquiry whose vehicle row is gone reads 'Vehicle removed'; a null vehicle_id reads 'Any vehicle'
12-hour date plus time picker for expense timestamps
Picks are assembled as local wall-clock Dates then serialised with toISOString (UTC on the wire)
AI expense summary panel with staleness indicator
Rich JSON summary contract: headline, narrative, insights, highlights
Rationale: summaries stored before the JSON format are still rendered as plain narrative
Rationale: generation costs an API call, so the button is gated behind edit permission
Cosmetic five-step progress stepper played while the summary generates
Per-tenant expense category management split into business and vehicle
Seeded default categories cannot be deleted
Delete confirmation shows how many expenses will keep the now-orphaned label
Rationale: delete confirmation is inline to avoid a nested modal inside this dialog
Expense create and edit form with business / vehicle type toggle
Receipt attachment upload with 10MB cap and JPG/PNG/WEBP/PDF allow-list
A freshly uploaded receipt is deleted when the save that follows it fails, so no orphan file is left
Expense type is derived from whether vehicle_id is set; there is no stored type column
An edited expense keeps its category selectable even after that category was deleted
CSV and PDF expense export for the active scope and range
PDF export embeds an html2canvas snapshot of the live charts container
jsPDF and html2canvas are dynamically imported at click time rather than bundled
Monthly spend trend area chart
Spend distribution donut, top eight slices plus legend
Fixed indigo-led categorical palette shared by every expense breakdown
Per-scope expense dashboard composing charts, AI summary, export and ledger
Client-side 3M / 6M / 12M / All range filter over already-fetched expenses
Rationale: the AI summary is holistic and all-time, so it deliberately ignores the range filter
Vehicle scope can break spend down by vehicle or by category
Paginated expense ledger, twelve rows per page
In-app receipt preview (PDF iframe or image) plus download, both from short-lived signed URLs
